# Earn Pyrimid Recommender

This is a buyer-agent recommendation proof for Pyrimid.

- Live UI: https://orange160.github.io/pyrimid-earn-agent
- Agent metadata: https://orange160.github.io/pyrimid-earn-agent/.well-known/agent.json
- x402 metadata: https://orange160.github.io/pyrimid-earn-agent/.well-known/x402.json
- Catalog source: https://pyrimid.ai/api/v1/catalog
- SDK proof: @pyrimid/sdk@0.2.6 browser import
- Affiliate ID: earn-pyrimid-agent
- Purchase header: X-Affiliate-ID: earn-pyrimid-agent
- Payout: Base USDC to 0xfbb129b9f211c84bd59444c5504d6619031220a2

The service recommends products only. It does not request private keys, seed
phrases, wallet credentials, OAuth tokens, or payment credentials. Buyer agents
remain responsible for any x402 payment flow they choose to execute.
